description.en-US: Old Brain Fix is a note and reminder app for Android. A desktop app for Linux, Windows and macOS uses the same data. There is no account and no server; all data is stored on the user's own devices. Capture • Text, photo and voice Notes, opened from the + button, home-screen widgets, Quick Settings tiles, app shortcuts, or a hardware button where the phone allows assigning one. • Content shared from other apps is saved as a Note. • Each Note records the time of capture. Optional: the location (shown as a Named Place such as "Home" when one matches), the current calendar event and the connected Bluetooth device. • Voice Notes are transcribed on the device with Whisper (English and German). The speech model (148 MB) is downloaded once, on request. • Text in photos and screenshots is recognised on the device with RustO, German letters and the euro sign included. • Transcripts and recognised text are included in search. Organising • New Notes are kept in Unsorted. A notification (Nudge) reports Unsorted Notes at a set interval; Quiet Hours suppress it at night. • Notes are filed into Areas and Topics (two levels), each with a colour and an icon. A starter set of Areas is offered at first start. • Notes can be edited, amended and merged. Deleted items stay in the trash for 30 days. • A Note can become a Checklist, a Shopping List whose items come back after a set number of days, weeks, months or years, a Tally with entries and charts, or a Session that picks Tallies. Its text can be formatted with headings, lists, tables, code blocks, boxes to tick and links that open other Notes and places in the app. Routines and Reminders • Any Note can have Reminders (one time) and Routines (repeating by a recurrence rule, several times a day if needed). • Alarms ring at the exact minute, also on the lock screen, and are restored after a restart. This requires the "Alarms & reminders" permission. • An alarm that is neither marked Done nor snoozed rings again at a set interval (Re-nag, default 10 minutes). Optionally, after a set number of repeats it is shown as a full-screen alarm with sound. • The Agenda lists today's Routines and Reminders, missed ones and the number of Unsorted Notes. It is also available as a home-screen widget. • Each Routine has a history with streak and adherence. • Routines and Reminders can be written to a device calendar or exported as an ICS file. Sync and sharing • Phone and desktop sync directly over the local network (TLS, paired by QR code or typed code), through a shared folder such as Syncthing or Nextcloud (end-to-end encrypted), or through an encrypted file sent with any app. • A single Area can be shared with another person. Other Areas are not shared. • Your Profile unites all of your Devices. Your name, a unique code and an optional picture show on the Notes you share with others. • A Note can be sent to another person as a file, together with its Routines and Reminders. The receiver can accept or decline it. • Notes, Topics or whole Areas can be handed to others as a Pack of copies, which they keep as their own. Privacy and security • No account, no server, no analytics, no advertising. • The app uses the network only for sync and for the speech model download. • Optional App Lock (PIN, fingerprint) and Area Locks. Capture and alarms keep working while locked. • Encrypted Backups (Argon2id, XChaCha20-Poly1305) into a chosen folder, optionally weekly, with a printable Recovery Sheet. Optionally, Android's backup to Google stores the encrypted Backup file and nothing else. Other • English and German. Light and dark theme. • Free and open source, licensed under Apache-2.0 or MIT.
